name: vision
description: Vision packages a lightweight engineering workflow and focused skills for repository guidance and persistent services.

interface.shortDescription: Useful engineering guidance without process overhead.
interface.longDescription: Vision combines a lightweight outcome-driven engineering workflow with focused skills for bootstrapping repository instructions and keeping requested services alive through independent verification. It avoids contracts, lifecycle state, checksums, receipts, and other proof-of-process requirements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Vision to take this engineering outcome end to end.
